definition: RuneQuest's self-contained mythic fantasy setting in the declared core-rulebook witness.
cultural_caution: Glorantha draws on multiple real-world influences but is a fictional setting; do not map its cultures, myths, or religions onto real peoples, traditions, or history.

supports: Chaosium describes Glorantha as a complete, self-contained universe for RuneQuest.

definition: Pervasive Gloranthan metaphysical inspirations associated with character identity and magical capability in the declared edition family.
cultural_caution: Source-specific game-and-setting concept; it is not a direct equivalence to any real script, divination, spirituality, or occult practice.

supports: Chaosium states that Runes permeate Glorantha and their mastery enables magic and brave deeds.

definition: The fictional religious/magical affiliation framework used in core character creation and Gloranthan society.
cultural_caution: Gloranthan gods and cults are fictional setting institutions. Do not conflate them with real deities, living religions, ritual offices, or moral alignments.

citations.locator: Product description, Character Creation and Glorantha religion text
supports: Chaosium identifies cult selection in character creation and fictional gods/cults as active in Gloranthan events.

definition: The declared RuneQuest core approach in which characters advance skills and abilities through use rather than class/level advancement.
cultural_caution: Edition-specific game mechanics, not a claim that all Gloranthan people have the same capacities or that other RuneQuest editions use identical rules.

citations.locator: Product description, Character Creation and skill-advancement text
supports: Chaosium describes skill/ability advancement through use and rejects class/XP framing for this product.

definition: The named major conflict horizon identified in the official Quickstart's Glorantha introduction.
cultural_caution: A fictional historical/mythic framework, not a real-world war analogy or a deterministic mandate for a player character's story.

supports: Chaosium identifies Glorantha as approaching the Hero Wars.
